name: One Hit Knight — complete knight variants and separate weapons

knight.gold.notes: Complete independently authored gold knight, including helmet, body, arms, boots, red plume and cape. No separate armor layer. Four separately authored direction atlases; true rear UP view. No baked weapons.

knight.shadow.notes: Complete independently authored shadow knight, including helmet, body, arms, boots, red plume and cape. No separate armor layer. Four separately authored direction atlases; true rear UP view. No baked weapons.

knight.phoenix.notes: Complete independently authored phoenix knight, including helmet, body, arms, boots, red plume and cape. No separate armor layer. Four separately authored direction atlases; true rear UP view. No baked weapons.

knight.vampire.notes: Complete ImageGen character redraw: helmet, armor, arms, boots and cape are drawn together into every pose. Four authored directional sheets; 224 frame cells; no armor overlay and no baked weapon.

knight.thunder.notes: Complete ImageGen character redraw: helmet, armor, arms, boots and cape are drawn together into every pose. Four authored directional sheets; 224 frame cells; no armor overlay and no baked weapon.

weapon.sword.notes: Original built-in ImageGen raster sheet: 32 independently authored cells in right/down/left/up direction rows, with eight attack poses per facing. Cropped and nearest-neighbor packed with registered grip alignment to directional hand positions. Other animation names select explicit held poses; they are not additional authored cycles.

knight.steel.method: Original complete silver-blue knight retained as the Steel variant; four individually authored directional sheets, packed into one transparent atlas.

knight.gold.method: Reference edits of original complete knight direction atlases; whole-cell crops, small neighboring component cleanup, nearest-neighbor scale and atlas packing only. No programmatic recolor, no armor overlay.

knight.shadow.method: Reference edits of original complete knight direction atlases; whole-cell crops, small neighboring component cleanup, nearest-neighbor scale and atlas packing only. No programmatic recolor, no armor overlay.

knight.phoenix.method: Reference edits of original complete knight direction atlases; whole-cell crops, small neighboring component cleanup, nearest-neighbor scale and atlas packing only. No programmatic recolor, no armor overlay.

knight.vampire.method: Four built-in ImageGen reference edits of the original knight, complete character redrawn per direction; source cells cropped, disconnected specks removed, nearest-neighbor resized and packed.
knight.vampire.notes: Front/side/back views visually inspected; north is a true rear helmet and cape view. No code drawings, palette replacements or armor compositing.

knight.thunder.method: Four built-in ImageGen reference edits of the original knight, complete character redrawn per direction; source cells cropped, disconnected specks removed, nearest-neighbor resized and packed.
knight.thunder.notes: Front/side/back views visually inspected; north is a true rear helmet and cape view. No code drawings, palette replacements or armor compositing.

weapon.sword.coverage: 8 attack frames per direction; held poses for idle/run/dash/block/death/victory
